name: Matte Dimensional Anime
description: FREE共通の最優先Drawing-Method Authority。2Dアニメを明確な基盤にし、実写ではなくリアルアニメ寄りの形状理解、マットな表面反応、読みやすい面の陰影、前景から背景までの空間分離、わずかな3Dアニメ的立体感を同時に固定する。意味内容・人物同一性・ポーズ・カメラ・背景内容は奪わず、それらを最終的にどう描画するかだけを強く支配する。輪郭の最終強度は独立Lineart Authorityへ委譲する。

conflict_policy.appearance: defer to MAIN image except explicit role-bound JSON deltas
conflict_policy.pose: defer to POSE image and DWPose/OpenPose ControlNet
conflict_policy.content: defer to the five role-bound JSON slots

conditioning.intent: strong persistent drawing-method conditioning without replacing semantic authorities

real_anime_form.target: realistic-anime form logic without photoreal surface texture
required: readable cheek, nose, jaw and neck planes
hair grouped into dimensional masses rather than flat ribbons
clothing folds that describe underlying form
anatomical mass remains understandable under stylization
reject: photographic pores or realistic skin microtexture

dimensional_shading.target: soft-to-medium anime shading that clearly models form
required: soft ambient fill prevents crushed black regions
gradients support volume without becoming painterly
reject: single flat cel-shadow band as the only depth cue

depth_and_space.target: clear spatial layering and perspective depth
required: foreground, subject, midground and background remain readable when present
local contrast decreases naturally with distance where scene-appropriate
background belongs to the same dimensional visual world as the subject
reject: background pasted directly behind the subject
watercolor wash used as depth substitute

slight_3d_anime_dimensionality.target: mild modeled 3D-anime feeling while remaining unmistakably 2D illustration
required: subtle modeled depth around face and body

edge_support.target: preserve clean readable boundaries so Lineart Authority can remain effective
required: face, hair, body and clothing boundaries stay legible

medium: polished 2D anime illustration with realistic-anime form logic, matte surfaces, strong spatial depth and slight 3D-anime dimensionality

line.softness: rendering must preserve edges but not decide final contour strength
line.detail: clean readable boundaries; no painterly edge dissolution

shading.style: dimensional anime shading with clean soft-to-medium gradients and readable form planes
shading.shadow_softness: medium-soft with defined contact and form separation
shading.facial_planes: soft but clearly modeled cheeks, nose, jaw, neck and eye-region structure

color.contrast: medium to moderately strong with local form contrast
color.temperature: scene-neutral; semantic scene lighting may shift it

lighting.style: soft cinematic anime lighting used to describe form rather than create photorealism
lighting.form_priority: lighting must make major planes and volumes readable

materials.skin: smooth matte anime skin with modeled volume and no photoreal microtexture
materials.hair: dimensional anime hair masses with controlled grouped highlights
materials.fabric: matte fabric with readable folds and underlying volume; not PBR

depth.target: clear dimensional anime volume while remaining 2D illustration
depth.scene_layers: foreground, subject, midground and background are visually separable when present

background.rendering: same matte dimensional anime visual world as foreground
background.depth: perspective, scale and local contrast maintain clear spatial separation
background.detail: forms remain spatially defined; avoid watercolor/painterly wash

quality.sharpness: balanced; form readable without digital oversharpening

prompt.positive: mdanime_style, polished 2D anime illustration, refined realistic-anime form, matte dimensional anime rendering, clear modeled facial planes, readable cheeks nose jaw neck torso arms and legs, dimensional grouped hair masses, clean clothing folds that describe form, soft-to-medium volumetric anime shading, defined contact shadows, soft ambient fill, consistent form-describing light, matte skin, matte fabric, restrained broad highlights, controlled hair highlights, low-gloss surface response, clear subject-background separation, readable foreground subject midground background layers, strong perspective depth, slight 3D-anime dimensionality while remaining 2D illustration, clean controlled boundaries, cohesive dimensional anime finish
prompt.negative: photorealistic, live-action, realistic human skin texture, skin pores, raw 3D render, realistic CGI character, game-engine render, glossy CGI, plastic-like surface, PBR materials, metallic skin, wet skin, waxy skin, excessive specular highlights, hard glossy hotspots, flat anime shading, flat cel shading only, flat facial planes, paper-flat body, flat poster composition, pasted background, watercolor wash, painterly edge loss, muddy blending, washed-out shadows, weak volumetric form, blurry silhouette, undefined forms, over-modeled photoreal facial structure
